why: Two seats of ours harass each other (sweep-casts-what-its-spawns-land's self-play start). A sweep casts the cheapest harasser that out-reaches a room's armed bodies, one a room within its spawns' share: no sweep asks more than one body at once (`askedMost`). On d561ef96, before, alpha's sweeps asked several at once on every seed 1-5 (beta on 4). Bodies lost and sweep cost are guardrails about 30% over the seed maxima: bodies 55 alpha, 57 beta, sweep cost 46,780 energy. Across harmless plan perturbations of seed 1 (builder scan reversed, pathfinder heap order, wall road cost, every combination, on main and the centre-first planner) bodies lost reach 60 alpha and 71 beta, so 78 and 92. No bound on his economy bodies dying beside beta's sweeps: that count measured kills by Defend bodies the sweeps absorbed, and once a sweep takes in only harasser-shaped bodies it fell (28 -> 10 here), and over 16 paired self-play seeds the rival's economy bodies killed fell too (24.3 -> 18.4 a seed, 95% interval -9.9..-2.4) while the rival's harvest showed no measurable change (+0.7%, 95% interval -19k..+63k of 2.8M dug); a harassment guard should read the harvest it denies
